rechner:sparplanrechner: The expected return is an assumption, not a guarantee. Historically, broad world ETFs often returned around 6–8% p.a. before costs and inflation — the future may differ.
rechner:zinseszinsrechner: The interest rate is an assumption, not a guarantee — for a savings or fixed-term account it's usually contractually fixed or variable, for securities it's only an expected value. Taxes (capital gains tax) are not included in this simple version.
rechner:kreditrechner: This calculator assumes a classic annuity loan with a constant monthly payment, no extra repayments or arrangement fees. The real effective rate of your actual offer may differ — compare real offers in our loan comparison.
rechner:baufinanzierungsrechner: This calculator models a classic German annuity mortgage (Annuitätendarlehen) — a fixed monthly payment made up of interest and principal. It doesn't replace individual advice — your actual rate depends on creditworthiness, loan-to-value ratio, property type and region. Compare real offers e.g. via our mortgage broker comparison.
rechner:nettolohnrechner: Income tax is derived via a simplified annual calculation: instead of the official Vorsorgepauschale formula, we use the actual social/health insurance contributions paid — the official payroll tax program may give a slightly different result. Child allowances reduce (as in real payroll withholding) only the solidarity surcharge and church tax, not income tax itself — the full tax benefit only applies via your annual tax return. For a binding calculation, use a payslip or an official German wage/income tax calculator.
rechner:altersvorsorge-rechner: All returns are assumptions, not guarantees. This calculator models the pure savings and payout math — taxes, product costs and government subsidies are not included. Facts on Germany's new subsidized retirement account are below.
rechner:haushaltsbuch: Your entries are stored only in your browser (localStorage) — there's no login and no server that sees your data. That also means your entries aren't visible on another device or browser, and they're lost if you clear your browser data.
